App.name: School Uniform Sales
App.tagline: Point of sale for school uniforms

ForgotPassword.title: Forgot your password
ForgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and your administrator will help you reset your password.
ForgotPassword.success: If that account exists, your administrator has been notified.

ChangePassword.title: Set a new password
ChangePassword.subtitle: You must change your temporary password before continuing.
ChangePassword.hint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.

Accounts.title: User accounts
Accounts.subtitle: Create accounts and assign a role. Accounts are created here only — there is no public sign-up.
Accounts.createdBody: Share these credentials with the user securely. They must change the password on first login.
Accounts.forbidden: Only a Super Admin can create accounts.
Accounts.resetDoneBody: Share this with {name} securely. They must change it at next login.
Accounts.deleteConfirmBody: {name} will be removed permanently. If the account has any activity on record, delete is refused — deactivate it instead so their name stays on what they did.
Accounts.cannotSelf: You cannot do that to your own account.
Accounts.hasActivity: This account has activity on record and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.

passwordResetRequest.title: Password reset requested
passwordResetRequest.body: {email} needs a new password. Open Accounts to set a temporary one.

Audit.title: Audit log
Audit.subtitle: Every recorded action across the system. Append-only — no one can edit or delete an entry.

Catalogue.title: Catalogue & prices
Catalogue.subtitle: Create, edit and archive products. Only the Super Admin manages the catalogue.
Catalogue.archiveConfirmBody: "{name}" will disappear from the sale screen but stays in past records. You can restore it later.
Catalogue.duplicateWarning: A product with this garment and size already exists.
Catalogue.forbidden: Only a Super Admin can manage the catalogue.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard

overview.subtitle: Here's what's happening today.
overview.chartEmpty: No sales in this period yet.

Dashboard.readonlyBanner: Your account is read-only. Every write is blocked across the system (A-FR-2.2).
Dashboard.previewNote: Temporary preview — layout and styling are placeholders.

summary.seller: Operations only — production, sales, orders, returns and cancellations. You can never change a price.
summary.administration: Read-only across the whole system. You see everything and change nothing.
summary.maintenance: Full functional access, audited like everyone else.
summary.super_admin: Everything — plus the accounts, catalogue and prices no one else may touch.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.heading: Login to your account
Login.subtitle: Use the account provided by the school administrator.
Login.unexpectedError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Login.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
Login.accountInactive: This account has been deactivated. Contact your administrator.
Login.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

Search.title: Search
Search.subtitle: Find a sale, order or alteration by reference, student, parent or phone.
Search.label: Search

Sales.title: New sale
Sales.subtitle: Record a uniform sale and print the receipt.
Sales.cancelHint: The sale stays in history, marked cancelled, and the stock is put back. This cannot be undone.
Sales.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this sale being cancelled?
Sales.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.
Sales.cancelPageSubtitle: Void a sale. The reason is kept, stock is restored, and the sale stays in history — never edited or deleted.
Sales.liveHint: Recent sales still live. Cancelling asks for a reason and cannot be undone.
Sales.belowStockHint: The system shows less than you are selling. If the shelf says otherwise, the shelf is probably right — continue, and the override will be recorded.
Sales.saveUnknownBody: The sale may or may not have been recorded — we did not get an answer from the server. Check recent sales before trying again, so it is not recorded twice.
Sales.errorUnauthorized: You are not signed in. Sign in again and retry — nothing was lost.
Sales.errorProduct: A product on this sale is no longer available. Choose it again from the list.
Sales.errorGeneric: The sale could not be saved. Nothing was recorded, so you can try again.

Orders.title: Orders
Orders.subtitle: Record a garment paid for now and collected later.
Orders.measurementsHint: Notes for the tailor: chest, waist, sleeve, hem.
Orders.stockNotice: Stock is not reduced now â it decreases when the order is collected.
Orders.stepBackTo: This line will return to {status}. A reason is required.
Orders.cancelTitle: Cancel this line and refund it
Orders.cancelHint: The refund method may differ from how the parent originally paid.
Orders.collectHint: Tick what the parent is taking today. The rest stay Ready for a later visit.
Orders.collectorNameHint: Name of the person taking the garments
Orders.collectStockNotice: Stock is reduced when you confirm this collection.
Orders.selectLinesToCollect: Select at least one line to collect.

OpenJobs.title: Open jobs
OpenJobs.subtitle: Every order and alteration not yet closed. Oldest first.
OpenJobs.nothingOpen: Nothing is open. Everything has been collected, returned or cancelled.
OpenJobs.noMatches: No open job matches that search.

Alterations.title: Alterations
Alterations.subtitle: Take in a garment the parent already owns, to be resized or repaired.
Alterations.workRequiredHint: What must be done? Taken in at the waist, hem shortened, seam repaired…
Alterations.dueOnReturnHint: Left unticked, the slip shows this as due on return.
Alterations.noStockNotice: This garment belongs to the parent, so no step of an alteration ever changes stock.
Alterations.stepBackTo: This will return to {status}. A reason is required.
Alterations.cancelHint: The garment still goes back to its owner. A reason is required.
Alterations.recordPaymentHint: Payment may be taken at intake or when the garment goes back.
Alterations.slipFooter: The school is holding the garment described above. Please present this slip when collecting it.

BugReport.title: Report a problem
BugReport.subtitle: Tell us what went wrong. The page and browser are captured for you.
BugReport.whatHappenedHint: e.g. the total on the receipt was 2000 short, on a sale of three shirts
BugReport.screenshotFailed: That image could not be read.
BugReport.autoCaptured: Sent with this report: the page ({page}) and your browser details.
BugReport.thanks: Thank you — the report was sent.
BugReport.dashboardSubtitle: Problems reported from inside the app. Sentry covers crashes; these are everything else.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.subtitle: Values the school can change without a new deployment.
Settings.sizesHelp: The sizes offered as boxes when recording a sale, order or exchange. Products no longer carry a size — it is chosen at that moment. A custom size can still be typed at the counter.
Settings.lettersHint: Shown in the order you enter them, e.g. S, M, L, XL.
Settings.noSizes: No sizes yet — add at least one.
Settings.sizeErrRange: "From" must be less than or equal to "To".
Settings.sizeErrTooMany: That makes too many sizes — narrow the range.
Settings.returnPolicyHelp: How long after a sale each kind of return stays within policy. Nothing here ever blocks a return — outside these windows the seller is warned and must record a reason.
Settings.notRetroactive: Changing a window does not reclassify returns already recorded. Each one keeps the verdict it was given at the time.

hints.return_worn: Proposed default, pending confirmation: not permitted.

Settings.errorTooLong: That window is longer than 10 years. Check the number.
Settings.errorInvalid: Enter a whole number of days.
Settings.errorUnauthorized: Only the Super Admin can change the policy.
Settings.errorGeneric: The policy could not be updated. Nothing was changed.

Returns.verdictNotPermitted: {condition}: {kind} is not permitted under the current policy.
Returns.overrideAllowed: You can still proceed — give a reason below and it will be recorded as an override.
Returns.overrideReasonPlaceholder: Manufacturing defect, decision by the founder…
Returns.overrideReasonHint: Recorded separately from the reason above, attributed to you, and flagged for the administration.
Returns.title: Returns & exchanges
Returns.subtitle: A wrong size is the shop's problem to solve. Every return references its original sale, which is never changed.
Returns.startHint: A return always references the sale it came from. Pick one, or use the Return button on any receipt.
Returns.newSubtitle: The original sale is not modified. This is recorded as a separate, linked transaction.
Returns.needASale: Choose the sale this garment came from first.

kindHint.return: The garment comes back and nothing goes out. The full value is refunded.
kindHint.exchange: The garment comes back and another goes out. Only the difference moves.

Returns.conditionHint: As declared by the parent. It is not the system's job to judge the garment.
Returns.nothingReturnable: Every item on this sale has already been returned.
Returns.alreadyReturnedNote: {count} line(s) on this sale have already been fully returned.
Returns.refundMethodHint: May differ from how the sale was paid — a MoMo sale can be refunded in cash.
Returns.reasonHint: Required. This is what the return will be explained by months from now.
Returns.errorUnknown: Connection lost. The return may or may not have been recorded — check the list before trying again.
Returns.errorUnauthorized: You are not signed in. Sign in again and retry — nothing was lost.

Documents.title: Receipts & documents
Documents.subtitle: Every document the system has issued, newest first. Use search when you are looking for one; use this when you want to see what was issued.

Receipt.hasReturns: This sale has returns recorded against it. The sale itself is unchanged.
Receipt.title: Receipt

Reports.title: Reports
Reports.subtitle: Export sales data to Excel.
Reports.empty: No sales found for the selected period.

recon.title: Daily cash reconciliation
recon.netCashInBoxHint: Cash receipts minus cash refunds only. This should match the money physically in the box — mobile money is never included here.
recon.mobileMoneyHint: Check this total against the phone. It is not in the box.
recon.undeliveredHint: Value of orders paid in this period whose goods have not been collected yet — money in the box the school still owes goods against.

suite.title: Reports
suite.subtitle: Sales, production, orders and audit — export to Excel or PDF.
suite.none: No data for the selected period.

Adjustment.title: Adjust stock
Adjustment.reasonHint: e.g. damaged in production, physical count, defect, loss
Adjustment.ledgerNotice: The count is not overwritten — the difference is recorded as a movement, so the discrepancy stays visible.

Production.title: Record production
Production.subtitle: Enter garments as they come out of production. Stock rises from these entries — it is never typed in directly.
Production.waitingOrders: {orders} order(s) waiting for this size — {units} garment(s)

Errors.title: Something went wrong
Errors.description: The page could not be loaded.
Errors.noProfile: We couldn't load your account profile. Please sign out and try again, or contact the administrator.
Errors.accountDeactivated: This account has been deactivated. Please contact the administrator.

Validation.positive: Enter a number greater than zero.
Validation.selectProduct: Choose a product from the catalogue.
Validation.nonZero: Enter a quantity other than zero.
Validation.describeMore: Please describe what happened (at least 10 characters).
Validation.nothingToPay: There is no charge to pay.
Validation.workRequired: Describe the work required (at least 3 characters).
Validation.reasonRequired: A reason is required (at least 3 characters).
Validation.passwordSame: The new password must be different from the current one.
Validation.emailInUse: An account with this email already exists.
